blinds-and-curtains.title: Blinds & Curtain Installation Perth | Ellis Services Group
blinds-and-curtains.description: Blind installation, curtain rods and window furnishing repairs in Perth. Confirm measurements, brackets and fitting requirements with Ellis Services Group.
qa: Can you install blinds or curtain rods I have already bought?

We can fit supplied window furnishings after checking the product, opening size and mounting surface. Tell us the style, number of windows and whether the brackets and fittings are included. We confirm suitability and the installation scope before work begins.
Can a curtain rail pulling away from plasterboard be repaired?

The brackets, fixing points and damaged wall area need checking before the rail is refitted. The repair depends on the wall condition and the weight of the curtains. Avoid using a rail that is coming away from the wall until it has been assessed.
What needs checking before replacing broken roller blind brackets?

The blind model, bracket shape and fixing surface determine which replacement will fit. Corded blinds also need suitable child-safety arrangements. Fixed electrical connections for powered blinds require an appropriately licensed electrician.

carpet-repair.title: Carpet Repair Perth | Patches, Joins & Re-stretching
carpet-repair.description: Carpet repairs in Perth for ripples, damaged patches, loose edges and doorway joins. Ellis assesses matching material, underlay and repair options.
qa: Can a small burnt or damaged carpet patch be repaired?

A localised patch may be possible when a compatible donor piece is available. Carpet colour, pile direction and wear affect how the patch will look. Tell us the affected size and whether you have matching offcuts so we can assess the repair options.
Can loose carpet at a bedroom doorway be repaired?

Loose edges, joins and doorway transitions can be assessed for repair. We check the carpet tension and surrounding fixings before confirming the work. If the carpet is damp or there is a history of leaks, the moisture issue needs assessment first.

floor-sanding.title: Timber Floor Sanding Perth | Ellis Services Group
floor-sanding.description: Timber floor sanding in Perth with assessment of worn coatings, board condition and finish options. Confirm preparation and coating scope with Ellis.
qa: Can worn timber floors be sanded and recoated?

Suitable timber floors can be sanded and prepared for a compatible coating. We first assess the timber, existing finish and board condition. The agreed scope includes the accessible floor area, edges and your preferred colour and sheen.
Should loose boards or moisture damage be checked before floor sanding?

Yes. Board movement, moisture damage and protruding fixings need assessment before sanding starts. Surface finishing does not resolve an underlying moisture or support problem. Tell us about known leaks or movement when arranging the assessment.
What preparation is needed in an occupied home?

Tell us which rooms are occupied and what furniture needs moving. Access, dust isolation and ventilation affect the work plan. Existing coatings or unknown floor materials may need additional controls, which are confirmed during assessment.

new-carpet.title: New Carpet Installation Perth | Ellis Services Group
new-carpet.description: New carpet installation in Perth for bedrooms, living areas and managed properties. Ellis measures rooms and confirms underlay, joins and floor preparation.
qa: What is checked before new carpet is installed?

We measure rooms, stairs and transitions and assess the existing floor. Your preferred fibre, pile and room use help define the specification. Underlay, joins, preparation and any removal or disposal requirements are confirmed in the installation scope.
My bedroom door may rub after new carpet. What should I mention?

Tell us about the door clearance and the carpet and underlay you are considering. Floor height and doorway transitions need checking during the site measure. Any door adjustment is a separate item to agree before installation.
Can new carpet be laid over a damp or damaged floor?

The moisture source and damaged substrate need assessment before installation. Covering an unresolved floor problem can affect the new carpet and underlay. Tell us about leak history or suspect older materials before removal work is planned.

shower-screens.title: Shower Screen Installation & Repairs Perth | Ellis
shower-screens.description: Shower screen installation, replacement and hardware adjustments in Perth. Ellis checks the opening, glass condition, seals and fixing requirements.
qa: Can a shower screen door that does not close properly be adjusted?

Serviceable screens can be assessed for hinge, roller, seal or alignment adjustments. The glass, hardware and wall fixings need checking first. Do not force a door or handle cracked or unstable glass.
Will replacing a shower screen seal fix a leaking shower?

A failed screen seal may allow water to escape, but it is only one possible cause. We check the screen and visible junctions before agreeing the repair. Persistent moisture or damage outside the shower may need drainage or waterproofing assessment.
What is measured for a replacement shower screen?

The opening, wall alignment and floor conditions determine the screen configuration and fixing requirements. Tell us your preferred framed, semi-frameless or frameless style. Glazing and wet-area penetrations require suitable methods and qualified work where applicable.

tiling.title: Tiling & Tile Repairs Perth | Ellis Services Group
tiling.description: Wall and floor tiling, cracked tile replacement and regrouting in Perth. Ellis assesses matching tiles, substrate condition and moisture before quoting.
qa: Can just one cracked kitchen floor tile be replaced?

A localised replacement may be possible if a compatible tile is available and the surrounding surface is sound. We assess the damaged tile and substrate before confirming the scope. Repeated cracking or loose tiles may point to a larger problem underneath.
Can you renew grout that is falling out between shower tiles?

Grout or sealant can be renewed after checking the underlying condition. Loose tiles, movement and persistent moisture need assessment before surface repairs. Regrouting does not replace a failed waterproofing membrane.
What affects the cost of a small tiling or regrouting job?

The area, tile size, layout, matching material and preparation needed affect the quote. Access and the condition of the existing surface also matter. Tell us whether tiles are supplied and about any known moisture or movement issue.

waterproofing.title: Bathroom & Wet Area Waterproofing Perth | Ellis
waterproofing.description: Bathroom, balcony and wet area waterproofing enquiries in Perth. Ellis assesses substrates, membranes, drainage interfaces and the required qualified work.
qa: How is shower resealing different from waterproofing?

Resealing addresses surface joints and sealant. Waterproofing addresses the membrane and its detailing beneath or behind the finishes. Replacing silicone cannot be assumed to fix membrane failure; an active leak needs diagnosis before the repair scope is agreed.
What needs checking before waterproofing a bathroom or balcony?

The substrate, corners, penetrations, wastes and planned finishes all affect the membrane system. Drainage and relevant building requirements also need checking. The work must be completed by appropriately qualified people, with any required licensing confirmed for the scope.
Should visible leak damage be assessed before new tiles go down?

Yes. Tell us where moisture appears, when the leak occurs and which surfaces have been affected. The cause and substrate condition need assessment before membrane or finish work proceeds. New tiles alone do not establish that the leak has been resolved.

door-installation.title: Door Installation Perth | Internal & External Doors
door-installation.description: Internal and external door installation in Perth. Ellis checks openings, frames, hinges, clearances and product requirements before confirming the fit.
qa: Can a new internal door be fitted to the existing frame?

It may be possible if the frame is sound and the opening suits the new door. We measure the opening and check hinges, clearances and the swing area. Damaged or distorted frames may require additional work within the agreed scope.
Do I need a replacement door if the bedroom door rubs after new carpet?

Not necessarily. The door, hinges, frame and new floor clearance need assessment first. An adjustment may be enough, depending on the door construction and condition. We confirm whether adjustment or replacement is suitable before agreeing the work.
Are entry, security or fire-rated doors fitted in the same way as internal doors?

These doors can have specific product, hardware, fixing and compliance requirements. Tell us the door location and any known rating or security requirement. Relevant qualifications and any required licences must be checked; regulated lock work is not assumed to be ordinary door fitting.

skylights.title: Skylight Installation & Repairs Perth | Ellis
skylights.description: Skylight installation, replacement and leak assessment in Perth. Ellis checks roof type, ceiling layout, flashing and access before confirming the scope.
qa: Can a skylight be added to a dark room?

A suitable location depends on the roof type, ceiling layout and the light or ventilation you want. We assess the room and roof before confirming the unit and installation scope. Roof access and weatherproofing requirements form part of that assessment.
Does a leaking skylight always need replacing?

Not always. Flashing, seals and surrounding junctions need checking, along with possible condensation. Tell us when moisture appears and the existing unit details if known. The assessment determines whether a component repair or replacement is appropriate.
Do powered skylight blinds need an electrician?

Fixed electrical work or nearby wiring requires an appropriately licensed electrician. Tell us if the existing or proposed unit has powered blinds or controls. The electrical requirements must be confirmed alongside roof and ceiling work.

window-installation.title: Window Installation & Replacement Perth | Ellis
window-installation.description: New and replacement window installation in Perth. Ellis measures openings and confirms frame, glazing, flashing, seals and access requirements.
qa: Can an old window be replaced within the existing opening?

A replacement can be assessed against the opening dimensions, wall construction and surrounding condition. We confirm the frame, glazing and opening style before agreeing removal and installation. Changes to the structural opening require separate assessment.
Should a sticking timber window be repaired or replaced?

The frame, hardware and extent of damage need checking before that decision. A serviceable window may suit repair; extensive deterioration may make replacement more appropriate. We assess the existing condition and confirm the proposed scope.
What details matter for an upstairs window replacement?

The storey level, access and wall construction affect the installation plan. Glazing and elevated work require qualified people and suitable controls. Energy, bushfire or heritage requirements may also affect product selection and must be checked where applicable.

cabinet-makers.title: Cabinet Makers Perth | Custom & Replacement Cabinetry
cabinet-makers.description: Custom and replacement cabinetry in Perth for kitchens, laundries and wardrobes. Ellis measures layouts and assesses cabinet alterations and appliance fit.
qa: Can you make fitted cabinetry for a kitchen, laundry or wardrobe?

Cabinet-making work can cover custom storage, replacement units, doors, drawers and panels for an agreed layout. We measure the space and confirm materials, hardware and items to retain. Appliance dimensions and service locations are checked before the specification is finalised.
Does a dropped cupboard door mean the whole cabinet needs replacing?

Not necessarily. The hinge, fixing points and cabinet panel need assessment to distinguish a hardware fault from damage to the cabinetry. Tell us if screws have pulled out or the panel is swollen. We confirm suitable repair, alteration or replacement options after inspection.
Can existing cabinetry be altered for a different dishwasher or oven?

Cabinet alterations depend on the appliance dimensions, available space and condition of the existing units. Provide the new model details and items you want to retain. Electrical, gas or plumbing changes require the relevant licensed trades and are checked as part of the project scope.

dishwasher-repair.title: Dishwasher Repair Perth | Drainage, Leaks & Cycle Faults
dishwasher-repair.description: Dishwasher repair assessment in Perth for drainage, filling, leaks and incomplete cycles. Provide the model and symptoms so Ellis can confirm repair options.
qa: Can a dishwasher that will not drain be repaired?

Drainage faults can be assessed once the model and symptoms are identified. Accessible pumps, hoses and related components are checked within the service scope. Repair depends on the fault, appliance condition and availability of compatible parts.
What should I provide if my dishwasher stops mid-cycle?

Tell us the brand, model, displayed error code and when the cycle stops. Mention whether it fills, heats or drains and whether any water is leaking. These details help define the assessment; the fault still needs checking before a repair is confirmed.
What if water is leaking near the dishwasher's electrical parts?

Stop using the appliance. Disconnect power only where safe and do not touch wet electrical components. The fault and installation need qualified assessment, with any regulated electrical or plumbing work completed by appropriately licensed people.

glass-glaziers.title: Glaziers & Glass Replacement Perth | Ellis Services Group
glass-glaziers.description: Glass replacement and glazing assessment in Perth for broken panes, failed seals and selected mirrors. Ellis confirms glass type, frame condition and access.
qa: Can a broken window pane be replaced without replacing the frame?

A pane replacement may be suitable if the frame can safely accept the correct glass. A qualified glazier checks the frame, dimensions and safety glazing requirements. Keep people and pets away from damaged glass and do not handle it.
Can you install a mirror on a brick or plasterboard wall?

Selected mirror installations can be assessed against the mirror dimensions, weight and wall construction. The glass product, support and fixing method need confirming before installation. Concealed services and the condition of the wall also affect the scope.
What should I tell you about cracked glass upstairs?

Give the location, storey level and frame type if known. Photos from a safe position are optional; do not approach damaged glass to measure it. Qualified glazing assessment and suitable access controls are needed before the work is confirmed.

ikea-kitchens.title: IKEA Kitchen Installation Perth | Ellis Services Group
ikea-kitchens.description: IKEA kitchen cabinet assembly and installation in Perth. Ellis checks your final plan, order list, room readiness and appliance interfaces before quoting.
qa: Can you assemble and install an IKEA kitchen I have already ordered?

We can assess installation of a confirmed modular kitchen design. The final plan, order list and delivery status help establish the cabinet inventory and room readiness. The scope covers agreed frames, fronts, panels and fittings once the site requirements are checked.
What needs to be ready before IKEA kitchen cabinets are installed?

The plan and inventory need confirming, along with room dimensions, wall condition and service locations. Tell us about benchtops, appliances, splashbacks and items to retain. Missing parts or unfinished preparation can affect the agreed installation sequence.
Does kitchen cabinet installation include plumbing, gas and electrical connections?

Cabinet installation and regulated connections need their own defined scopes. Appliance and benchtop interfaces are checked during planning. Electrical, gas, plumbing and any applicable structural or waterproofing work require appropriately qualified people and required licences.

oven-repair.title: Oven Repair Perth | Heating, Fans, Doors & Controls
oven-repair.description: Oven repair assessment in Perth for heating, fan, door and control faults. Ellis checks the model, fuel type and parts availability before confirming repairs.
qa: Can an oven that no longer heats be repaired?

No-heat and uneven-heating faults can be assessed for repair. Tell us the model, fuel type and which functions are affected. The fault, appliance condition and parts availability determine whether component replacement is viable.
Can damaged oven door hinges or seals be replaced?

Serviceable hinges and seals may be replaced when compatible parts are available. The door and surrounding components need checking first. Provide the appliance model and describe whether the door drops, fails to close or lets heat escape.
What should I do if the oven sparks, overheats or smells of gas?

Stop using it and arrange qualified assessment. Do not attempt to dismantle the appliance or test it again. Gas and hard-wired electrical work require appropriately licensed people; the relevant requirements are confirmed before repair.

upholstery-repair.title: Upholstery Repair Perth | Fabric, Cushions & Seating
upholstery-repair.description: Upholstery repairs in Perth for torn seams, worn fabric, cushions and seating support. Ellis assesses the furniture, matching needs and material options.
qa: Can a torn chair seam or worn fabric panel be repaired?

Localised seam or fabric repairs may be suitable after the item is assessed. The condition of the surrounding material and availability of a match affect the options. We confirm whether a repair or recovering the selected piece is more appropriate.
Can sagging cushions or seat support be replaced?

Padding, webbing and support materials can be assessed for replacement in suitable furniture. The frame and upholstery condition need checking first. Tell us which part has lost support and whether the furniture has a broken mechanism or an unstable frame.
What details help define an upholstery repair quote?

Describe the furniture item, damaged area and any fabric or colour matching you need. Approximate dimensions and safely taken photos are optional. Mould, pest contamination or unstable components may need separate treatment before upholstery work proceeds.
